name: 見出し付きの作業データベース操作部
prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. LH09-0048 complete Japanese task database heading/controls only.
ORIGINAL images1/2 PRIMARY for icon geometry, stroke/optical weight, proportions, grouping and fine details; image3 mock SECONDARY Japanese copy. Related images4/5 are reference candidates for restored controls/colors, not typography authority. Do not copy mock omissions/substitute symbols.
Compact THREE horizontal tiers, corresponding to original crop: top original outline rounded-square check glyph plus「作業」in Meiryo Bold20/28. Middle toolbar: five tabs「案件別」「今の期間」「未着手」「自分の作業」「担当者」; original table/grid icons except kanban-column icon for tab2. First selected via thin forest-green underline. Then plus. Right「絞り込み」「並べ替え」, thin search magnifier, ellipsis, forest-green gradient split「新規作成」button and separate down-chevron segment. Restore split button omitted by mock.
Bottom: five inactive white outline pills with original status-radial / people / calendar (divider+two horizontal interior lines) / diagonal relation arrow / relation arrow; labels「状態」「担当者」「期日」「期間」「案件」; each down chevron. Then thin plus and「条件を追加」plain unboxed.
Official white canvas, quiet separator under middle tier, compact aligned density, no enclosing card or data rows. Body Meiryo Regular14/24, metadata12/16, tracking0. All supporting glyphs slate #526173. Primary gradient #174C36→#1F6444→#2D8F5E, white label, subtle edge, restrained shadow. Only selected underline and primary action green; pills inactive neutral white. Preserve exact wording/count/control order; no giant heading, heavy body, extra fields or decorative panels.
reviewNotes: Three-tier Japanese header checked: original checkbox, five views with correct type icons, filter/sort/search/menu, restored split create, five inactive filter pills/add-condition. White/slate/green states coherent. Exact font/vector and behavior unproved.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
